📖 How to use

  1. Enter your home's current market value.
  2. Enter your remaining mortgage balance.
  3. Read your equity, equity percentage and available credit at 80% CLTV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is home equity?

Equity = current home value − remaining mortgage balance. As you pay down the loan or the home appreciates, equity grows.

How is the 80% credit line limit calculated?

Most lenders cap combined loan-to-value (CLTV) at 80%: max credit = (80% × home value) − mortgage balance.

What if the available credit is zero?

If the result is zero or negative, you have no usable equity under the 80% CLTV rule — you owe close to (or more than) 80% of the home's value.
